headline: 🔴 Akira intrusion from one missing MFA control, 🎯 City-Forum raids Salesforce and ServiceNow guest portals, 🛡️ VMware vCenter flaw reaches 361 hosts, 💣 Clop and MajinaHanashi post ten victims in a day, ⚠️ Adobe ColdFusion and Commerce patch Priority 1, 📋 FulcrumSec dumps Novo Nordisk AI stack
summary: Ransomware dominates the landscape: one missing MFA control let Akira turn a credential spray into a full intrusion, leak sites posted a ten-victim wave, and FulcrumSec dumped Novo Nordisk's AI stack after unpaid demands. City-Forum's guest-portal raids and actively exploited Adobe and vCenter flaws round out a heavy patching day.
